text.description_html:
Acorn APFBP, Bean Smooth Iron Pull

Acorn's APFBP 6-3/4" pull made by Acorn is perfect to use on lightweight doors, garden gates, or as decorative pieces. The Bean Tip Cast Iron Garden Gate Door Pull is lightweight and easy to install with just a few screws. Made from cast iron, the smooth iron finish has a lifetime no-rust guarantee. Smooth iron hardware is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it was originally forged.

Specifications of the Bean Tip Cast Iron Garden Gate Door Pull Acorn APFBP:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Height: 6-3/4"
  • Width: 2-1/8"
  • Projection: 1-5/8"
  • Lifetime No-Rust Finish Warranty!

Sold individually. Package includes 1 pull and hardware for a surface mounted application.
